explanation: Matches erdosproblems.com/842: a graph on 3n vertices formed from n vertex-disjoint triangles plus a Hamiltonian cycle using only new edges — does it have chromatic number ≤ 3? (yes, Fleischner–Stiebitz). In Lean IsTrianglesPlusHamiltonianCycle G n says G = T ⊔ C with T and C edge-disjoint, T the disjoint union of n triangles (via an equivalence V ≃ Fin n × Fin 3, adjacency = distinct and same first coordinate), and C an isomorphic copy of cycleGraph (3n) on V, i.e. a Hamiltonian cycle. The statement asserts χ(G) ≤ 3 for all such G on any V : Type. Degenerate n are harmless (n = 1 is vacuous since the 3-cycle cannot be edge-disjoint from the triangle). Faithful.
